poses.caption: Lower the chest from a knee-supported push-up position.
Press up, keeping shoulders, hips and knees aligned.
Rotate open, supporting on the left hand and bent knee while the right arm reaches upward.
Return through the push-up position and rotate to the opposite side with the left arm raised.

jobs.detail: KNEELING PUSH-UP WITH TORSO ROTATION. FOUR square panels 2x2. Plain thin gray floor mat only, no bench. TOP LEFT: kneeling pushup LOWER, both knees grounded behind hips, straight line knees-hips-shoulders, palms flat shoulder width directly on FLOOR, elbows bent chest just above mat. TOP RIGHT: same kneeling pushup TOP, both knees grounded, hips extended same shoulder-hip-knee line, elbows fully extended hands floor. BOTTOM LEFT: rotate torso open to CAMERA, support LEFT hand on mat under left shoulder, LEFT knee and shin grounded, both knees stay bent; RIGHT arm straight reaches vertically ceiling, gaze raised hand. BOTTOM RIGHT: open torso AWAY from camera, RIGHT palm supports on mat under right shoulder, RIGHT knee/shin grounded; LEFT arm reaches ceiling. Clear opposite support arms, 3D rear view in last panel, elbow/hand continuity. Knee-supported side plank rotations, no full toe plank, no seated twist. Pectoral primary red soft blurred on chest shirt front only, back fabric stays black. Exposed anatomy detailed, clothing opaque all surfaces.
jobs.prompt: Edit original project FOUR-panel kneeling push-up/rotation male illustration. Preserve every pose and full-body framing: kneeling lower, kneeling top, front-open rotation and back-open opposite rotation. Preserve exposed detailed grayscale muscles. On ALL front chest shirt surfaces, erase EVERY radial ray, muscle-fiber line, pectoral division and bright radial burst. Replace with ONE large smooth soft BLURRED diffuse red oval tint centered on opaque matte black chest fabric, its smooth gradient completely independent of muscular divisions. Broad soft fabric folds/seams only. Back shirt stays black. Full opaque torso/shorts wraps front sides rear seat crotch. No text.

poses.caption: Balance on the sit bones with knees bent, feet lifted and hands clasped.
Rotate the torso toward the right while keeping the pelvis steady.
Rotate toward the left, keeping feet lifted and alternating sides.

jobs.detail: BODYWEIGHT SEATED RUSSIAN TWIST, THREE equal square panels side by side. Front three-quarter view showing both legs. Sit on floor thin gray mat, balance on sit bones, knees bent, BOTH FEET LIFTED visibly off floor throughout. Torso leans back slightly with neutral long spine, hips/pelvis and bent legs stay facing forward and unchanged. Hands CLASPED together in front of chest, no weight/no ball/no equipment. LEFT: center position hands together in front of sternum. CENTER: rotate SHOULDERS and chest toward MODEL RIGHT, clasped hands travel together beside right hip, head follows chest, pelvis stays facing forward. RIGHT: rotate shoulders/chest clearly opposite toward MODEL LEFT, clasped hands together beside left hip. Arms move with torso, not isolated arm swing; visible opposite chest/shoulder rotations, identical legs floating in all panels. Primary ABS only one smooth diffuse blurred red tint on intact abdominal shirt, no sixpack lines/fiber rays. Exposed grayscale arms/calves detailed. Full opaque shirt and shorts front sides back seat crotch.
jobs.prompt: Correct original project THREE-panel male bodyweight Russian twist. Preserve exact CENTERED SEATED LOWER BODY, pelvis orientation, bent knees and floating feet of FIRST panel in ALL THREE panels; same camera. Keep first neutral torso/hands at sternum. MIDDLE panel torso/shoulders rotate toward IMAGE LEFT with BOTH CLASPED HANDS visibly together beside IMAGE-LEFT HIP, outside torso silhouette on LEFT, head follows LEFT. LAST panel torso/shoulders rotate toward IMAGE RIGHT, BOTH clasped hands beside IMAGE-RIGHT HIP on RIGHT, head follows RIGHT. No mirrored legs or entire body turn, only shoulders/ribcage rotate on fixed pelvis. Two distinct opposite shoulder rotations. Opaque black shirt abdomen ONE soft smooth BLURRED red tint, erase every sixpack line/radial fiber. Preserve detailed exposed grayscale anatomy and full opaque clothing front sides back seat crotch. No text.
